# Timeline

> Static chronological events with independent status, connectors, descriptions, and metadata.

This file matches the installed `timeline` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/timeline.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/timeline.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/timeline-knobs`: `timelineKnobs`, types `TimelineKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/timeline`: `Timeline`, `TimelineItem`, `TimelineIndicator`, `TimelineSeparator`, `TimelineContent`, `TimelineTitle`, `TimelineDescription`, `TimelineMeta`, types `TimelineState`, `TimelineProps`, `TimelineItemProps`, `TimelineIndicatorProps`, `TimelineSeparatorProps`, `TimelineContentProps`, `TimelineTitleProps`, `TimelineDescriptionProps`, `TimelineMetaProps`

## Composition

### Anatomy

```tsx
<Timeline>
  <TimelineItem>
    <TimelineIndicator />
    <TimelineSeparator />
    <TimelineContent>
      <TimelineTitle />
      <TimelineDescription />
      <TimelineMeta>
        <SourceBadge />
      </TimelineMeta>
    </TimelineContent>
  </TimelineItem>
</Timeline>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { Check, CircleAlert, Search } from "lucide-react";

import { SourceBadge } from "@/components/control-ui/source-badge";
import { Spinner } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/spinner";
import {
  Timeline,
  TimelineContent,
  TimelineDescription,
  TimelineIndicator,
  TimelineItem,
  TimelineMeta,
  TimelineSeparator,
  TimelineTitle,
} from "@/components/control-ui/ui/timeline";

export function PrimitiveTimelineExample() {
  return (
    <Timeline className="mx-auto my-6 w-full max-w-lg">
      <TimelineItem state="success">
        <TimelineIndicator>
          <Check />
        </TimelineIndicator>
        <TimelineSeparator />
        <TimelineContent>
          <TimelineTitle>Searched product documentation</TimelineTitle>
          <TimelineDescription>Found the interaction and accessibility guidance needed for the implementation.</TimelineDescription>
          <TimelineMeta>
            <SourceBadge href="https://base-ui.com/react/components/popover" faviconSrc="https://base-ui.com/favicon.ico">
              Base UI
            </SourceBadge>
            <SourceBadge href="https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Popover_API">MDN</SourceBadge>
          </TimelineMeta>
        </TimelineContent>
      </TimelineItem>

      <TimelineItem state="success">
        <TimelineIndicator>
          <Search />
        </TimelineIndicator>
        <TimelineSeparator />
        <TimelineContent>
          <TimelineTitle>Compared source preview patterns</TimelineTitle>
          <TimelineDescription>Separated one-source links from multi-source disclosure.</TimelineDescription>
        </TimelineContent>
      </TimelineItem>

      <TimelineItem state="running">
        <TimelineIndicator>
          <Spinner />
        </TimelineIndicator>
        <TimelineSeparator />
        <TimelineContent>
          <TimelineTitle>Validating the rendered activity view</TimelineTitle>
          <TimelineDescription>Checking keyboard navigation, wrapping, and narrow viewports.</TimelineDescription>
        </TimelineContent>
      </TimelineItem>

      <TimelineItem state="error">
        <TimelineIndicator>
          <CircleAlert />
        </TimelineIndicator>
        <TimelineSeparator />
        <TimelineContent>
          <TimelineTitle>Preview deployment failed</TimelineTitle>
          <TimelineDescription>The build exited before the preview became available.</TimelineDescription>
        </TimelineContent>
      </TimelineItem>
    </Timeline>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `timeline`
  - `content`
  - `description`
  - `indicator`
  - `item`: `data-state` (`error` | `neutral` | `pending` | `running` | `success` | `waiting`)
  - `meta`
  - `root`
  - `separator`
  - `title`

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### timeline

- `--cui-timeline-indicator-background`: `var(--background)`
- `--cui-timeline-indicator-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)`
- `--cui-timeline-indicator-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)`
- `--cui-timeline-running-foreground`: `var(--primary-text)`
- `--cui-timeline-waiting-foreground`: `var(--warning-text)`
- `--cui-timeline-success-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-timeline-error-foreground`: `var(--destructive-text)`
- `--cui-timeline-separator-background`: `var(--border)`
- `--cui-timeline-title-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-timeline-title-font-weight`: `var(--font-weight-medium)`
- `--cui-timeline-item-padding-block`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 5)`
- `--cui-timeline-separator-inline-size`: `1px`
